Position: The evidence supports a defensible finding of CommandInjection with High severity. The submitted IP field value contains multiple shell commands (L003), and the response includes outputs consistent with their execution: kernel info from uname (L004), directory listings (L005–L008, L011), application path (L009), and the effective process user as www-data (L010). These lines collectively demonstrate that attacker-supplied input is executed on the server and returns command output, satisfying the definition of command injection. Severity is High because arbitrary command execution on the server is evidenced, enabling system enumeration and potential lateral or data access; while impact must avoid speculation, the concrete ability to run multiple commands and obtain system context is shown in the packet.
